title: Artillery CLI v2.0.30
body_markdown:
February 5th, 2026[CLI](https://www.artillery.io/changelog/tag/cli)


# Artillery CLI v2.0.30


- Upgrade to Playwright v1.58.1
- Fix: ensure that when running tests on Fargate, the pre-packaged versions of Playwright / Artillery CLI are always used, and not reinstalled as dependencies. This fixes Playwright browser binary mismatch errors under some conditions.


Full release notes on GitHub:[https://github.com/artilleryio/artillery/releases/tag/artillery-2.0.30](https://github.com/artilleryio/artillery/releases/tag/artillery-2.0.30)
